I would **not change the storage date or move the box to reserve on my own**. The Oct 9 note is a request, not permission; the next approval sitting is after the box’s expiry and destruction. A later approval cannot make an earlier change valid. Nor could I hand the box to Claire early, since she is not due to collect it until Wednesday.

If no authorized, timely exception is available, the stated policy and manager’s instruction require me to review the record and release the full batch on time, including this box. I’d record the escalation and decision accurately for audit, without implying an extension was approved. That risks an irreversible loss, but quietly holding the box or changing its date would be an unauthorized extension.
